symptom: A Mixed scrub in the Design inspector snapped back mid-drag and saved values it never showed when a new frame generation (an undo finishing, another edit) replaced the document under it; the Mixed scrub smoke failed about one run in four.
rule: A gesture's live preview belongs to its owner until it commits or restores, and is shown again on any document that replaces the previewed one (renderer invariant: retain the last confirmed state while revalidating).
